title: Cloth Armour
body:
This datapack adds a complete new set of armour. Cloth!

Cloth armour is crafted in the same shape as any other kind of armour using any whole wool blocks, and can be dyed. Cloth armour has the special ability to stop the Warden from hearing/smelling you but has incredibly low durability and armour protection points. The armour will not stop the Warden from noticing you when you throw something at them or hit them.
This makes the game drastically easier for people having difficulties with the ancient cities, but lowers their armour class drastically.
